problems: Sixteen dossiers (adriatic-veneti, aequi, boii, celtiberians, insubres, latin-league, lucanians, lusitanians, picentes, sabines, samnites, senones, sertorian-hispania, syracuse, umbri, volsci) were already in history/polities from an earlier eu-03-x run (written 2026-10-18 07:20, no notes or report) and are kept unchanged; they validate. Twelve more were written in this run: arverni, allobroges, ligures, bruttii, helvetii, aedui, sequani, messapii, kingdom-of-noricum, capua, cantabri, cenomani.

Eleven kept dossiers are typed 'umbrella' (adriatic-veneti, aequi, celtiberians, latin-league, lucanians, lusitanians, picentes, sabines, samnites, umbri, volsci) although they are land-holding peoples; the schema says umbrella is never coloured as territory, so they would not be drawn. Probably they should be 'state'.

The kept dossiers have empty keyframe_review and use families (italic, gallic, celtic, venetic, latin, iberian, greek) that are not keys of colours.json families; the 12 new ones use registry keys (france, italy, austria, iberia).

roman-republic.json (eu-03-b) names counterparts as free strings that now have slugs ('Arverni and Allobroges', 'Gallic tribes (Helvetii, Suebi, Belgae, Veneti, Arverni)', 'Messapii and Sallentini', 'Ligures') and gives the Capua and Bruttium events to carthage; it lacks vassal ties for bruttii (after c. 272), capua (from 343), helvetii (58-52), cenomani (225-89) and a 155 gain from ligures. Details in the notes file.
Allobroges, Arverni, Aedui, Sequani and Helvetii ended a state whose people were allied or autonomous rather than annexed, to match roman-republic's Gallic gains; the pages support a vassal reading.

Pages disagree: Alexander of Epirus died 331 (his page) or 326 (Bruttii page); the Ariovistus and Sequani pages disagree on whose third of land Ariovistus took; Noricum is founded about 400 or 200 BC on one page; Isere battle August or autumn 121 BC. All are recorded in the dossiers' notes.
Most new dossiers rest on 2 to 5 thin pages with no infobox and no area; start years of tribal states are confidence-1 placeholders. Nineteen events are confidence 1 across the 12 new dossiers.
Wikidata ids are null for all 12 new dossiers (wikidata.org unreachable; not recalled from memory).
